Under NKVD Mode, suspicion tracked every choice that read as ████████████ rather than obedience, and it has run out. The political apparatus, not the enemy, has judged this command a problem the front didn't have. What ███████ next ██████ a █████ range than the usual telling admits. Most officers recalled under circumstances like these in 1941 were shot or sent to the camps, often ██████ weeks and without a trial worth the name. A minority (Rokossovsky is the documented case, ████████ in 1937 and released in 1940 once the war made his competence too valuable to waste) were eventually reinstated, sometimes years later, sometimes at the front they'd been pulled from. Which of the two this recall turns out to be is not knowable from inside it, and the odds do not favor the second. The war continues without you. It was never yours to finish.One Year LaterThe war this command was pulled from ends in Berlin regardless, under ███████ answered for it after.
